name: The Green Drake
label: Quest
description: The Green Drake: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Now I set you on a dangerous hunt to slay the green drake, Morphaz, and bring his tooth to me. Morphaz dwells deep in Temple of Atal'Hakkar, the entrance to which lies in Swamp of Sorrows.
If you wish to defeat him, you must not go alone. This drake is an enemy of many -- seek others who wish to destroy him.
The drake's tooth represents the power a hunter will find in the company of others. Bring it to me and you will have learned much.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I see wisdom in your eyes, friend. Has your hunt ended?

clips.title: Completion
paras: You have learned the old ways, friend, and for that I offer you a gift from my days as an adventurer.
